findings.summary: The `test` script forwards a literal `--` to vitest, so `pnpm test -- <files>` ignores the file filters and runs all unit tests (4 files / 146 tests). The Done-when command still exits 0; per-file runs work with `pnpm test <files>` or `npx vitest run <files>`. The script is owned by phase-1-backend-foundation and was not changed by this review.

`pnpm test:e2e` for AC-dm-10 (8 blocks, 24 questions, rail numbers and answered marks) was not run: it needs the rendered questionnaire UI from the frontend units, which do not exist yet in this unit's scope. Deferred to integration.

`pnpm test:e2e` for AC-dm-11 ('?' button with aria-expanded; 'não sei' / 'não acompanho' only on mp1, mp3, cm1, mm1, co1) was not run: it needs the rendered questionnaire UI from the frontend units. Deferred to integration. The content-level rule is covered by tests/unit/questionBank.test.ts and passed.

`pnpm test:e2e` for AC-dm-29 (rendered-text scan of result screens and the PDF for forbidden terms) was not run: it needs the result screens and PDF export from later units. Deferred to integration. The content-level scan of shared/content is covered by tests/unit/forbiddenTerms.test.ts and passed.

evidence.summary: Done-when command. Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 146 passed (146). The literal `--` makes vitest run every unit test, not only the two named files.
Filtered run of the two unit files. Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 18 passed (18).

messages.text: Deferred e2e checks for this capability: (1) run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts` once the questionnaire frontend lands, for AC-dm-10 (8 blocks, 24 questions, rail numbers, answered marks) and AC-dm-11 ('?' with aria-expanded, unknown option only on mp1, mp3, cm1, mm1, co1); (2) run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/result.spec.ts` once the result screens and PDF export exist, scanning rendered text and the PDF for /\bV[1-4]\b/i, /m[ée]todo\s+V4/i, /V4\s+Company/i, /\bPPA\b/i, /\bCREP\b/i, /vacina/i (AC-dm-29). Also run the content-driven rule ACs (AC-dm-18 to AC-dm-26, AC-dm-49) after the rules and evaluate units land.

`pnpm test -- <files>` runs every unit test because of the literal `--` in the package.json test script (owned by phase-1-backend-foundation). For per-file QA runs use `pnpm test <files>` or `npx vitest run <files>`. Fixing the script is a foundation-unit change, not this unit's.
